feeds.title: Must Read Alaska
feeds.description: Explore in-depth, descriptive, and profound articles on the latest events in Politics and Culture. Must Read Alaska is news of people, politics, policy, culture, and happenings in Alaska. It is edited by Suzanne Downing, who first landed in Alaska in 1969, and has called it home ever since

feeds.title: Dermot Cole
feeds.description: Veteran Alaska newspaper columnist and author Dermot Cole offers news and commentary about Alaska politics. Keep up to date on the latest news and analytical articles diving into Alaska's current social and political landscape from Dermot Cole.

feeds.title: Alaska with attitude
feeds.description: Alaska with attitude is a blog about life in Alaska, its climate, wildlife, people and natural wonders with a bit of an edge.

feeds.title: Little House Big Alaska
feeds.description: Laura Sampson is on a mission to teach modern family oriented women how to make old-fashioned foods new again. A wife and mom of 3 boys, Laura understands the struggles of trying to serve a home-cooked meal each night. She provides recipes and cooking hacks for busy moms to create dishes they may think to take more time or skill than they have to make.

feeds.title: Fish Alaska Magazine
feeds.description: Fish Alaska magazine is a full-color, glossy publication produced ten times a year offering a variety of how-to articles, regional features, trip-planning advice, gear reviews, recipes, entertaining stories, and in-depth Alaska fishing information.

feeds.title: The Runner's Plate
feeds.description: I am Michelle, and I am pretty obsessed with running. I blog about my obsession with running, healthy eating, my husband and son, and our life in Alaska. I have developed training plans, for beginning runners to novice marathoners.

feeds.title: H-bomb's Alaska | My Back Yard
feeds.description: Welcome to My Back Yard. These short stories are my attempt to document some of my many fine Alaskan adventures.

feeds.title: Beneath the Borealis
feeds.description: I'm Julia. In 2015 I went on what I thought would be a quick trip to Alaska to 'get out of dodge'. Little did I know, Alaska had other plans for me. 17 days turned into the summer and I ended up falling in love (both with the place and with my person, a.k.a 'The Chief'). Now, I live in a cabin in the Alaskan wilderness. Join me in this out of the blue experience for all the laughs, bumps, bruises and lessons Alaska has in store.

feeds.title: Alaska Watchman
feeds.description: The Alaska Watchman publishes news of interest to people of conscience and people of faith. Alaska Watchman is a statewide news agency providing coverage of news and events focused on Alaska. Read commentary and incisive opinions on current social and cultural issues.

feeds.title: The Alaska Life
feeds.description: The Alaska Life was an idea born by Alaskans, for both fellow Alaskans and those that love Alaska.

feeds.title: Alaska Magazine
feeds.description: Alaska magazine has been sharing authentic Alaska since 1935. Today's Alaska is a vibrant and multifaceted place, and it guides you on adventures large and small while you explore life on the Last Frontier through images and stories by award-winning photographers and writers.

feeds.title: Unity Home Group Blog
feeds.description: Blog post on Buying & Selling a Home, Home Improvement, Homeowner Advice, Lifestyle, Real Estate, and more.Unity Home Group is Alaska's Real Estate Team in Anchorage & Eagle River. They help to make your home buying, selling and transaction process smoothly.

feeds.title: Alaska from Scratch
feeds.description: I'm Maya Wilson, a cookbook author and food columnist living in Alaska. Alaska, in addition to unparalleled scenery, has unique regional cuisine that I am uncovering and discovering day by day. From fresh halibut to wild salmon and from moose to bear, Alaska has food and a lifestyle that goes along with it that's all its own. Thank you for joining me as I walk this journey of exploring living and cooking in Alaska, from scratch.

feeds.title: Gray Line Alaska Blog
feeds.description: Gray Line Alaska offers travel vacations, tours, and sightseeing packages. Get the most out of your trip to Alaska with insider travel tips & secrets from Gray Line Alaska. Discover where to go, what to see & do, and so much more!

feeds.title: Allergy Free Alaska Blog
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Megan. Wife, mother, and gluten-free baker of 12+ years. Here you'll find my tasty from-scratch recipes that are always gluten-free and dairy-free, with some vegan and grain-free, too.

feeds.title: MyAlaskaGuide Blog
feeds.description: Angie and Lynne started working together in Alaska tourism in 1993. In 2005, they brought their individual and shared experiences together to provide professional tour guides, foreign language guides, and program management/staffing in Anchorage and beyond, all over Alaska and the Yukon. They have provided many and varied tour-related services for mom & pop group tours, wholesale FIT & tour companies, DMCs, local attractions, and large corporate & incentive travel groups.

feeds.title: Alaskan Thrill Blog
feeds.description: Alaskan Thrill is your gateway to discovering the best things to do in Alaska. From the iconic attractions to hidden gems, find detailed insights into the top destinations, activities, and experiences that Alaska has to offer. Whether you're interested in wildlife encounters, outdoor adventures, or cultural explorations, this blog has something for every type of traveler.

feeds.title: Northern Expenditure | A Personal Finance and Money Saving Blog in Alaska
feeds.description: Alaska is a remarkable, wonderful place. But things are a bit different here. While Alaska does pay us to live here, we also have to deal with a very high cost of living. So, we're going to try to navigate this journey in our own Alaskan way. We'll keep you updated on our plan progress and we'll also share our own money saving experiences and tips, talk about some awesome Alaskan stuff, highlight some behavioral economics research, and let you in on a little bit of our crazy.

feeds.title: A Taste of Alaska
feeds.description: Baking and cooking her way through the cold Alaska winters. With the help of her husband and four dogs, they manage to maintain sanity through adventures in kitchen and hometown, Fairbanks.

feeds.title: Set the Net
feeds.description: A snapshot of life in Bristol Bay, AK from Susie Jenkins-Brito

feeds.title: Alaska Bush Life
feeds.description: I'm Melissa Cook. I spent most of my adult life as a schoolteacher in remote Alaska while managing multiple sclerosis. Alaska Bush Life blog is an extension of my memoir - The Call of the Last Frontier.

feeds.title: Life in Alaska | A View From Homer
feeds.description: Alaska is a big place and no blog could sum it up. This is my slice of life living in Homer, Alaska.

feeds.title: Notes from the Fishing Grounds
feeds.description: We're Mark Stopha and Sara Hannan from Juneau, Alaska. We sell sustainably harvested salmon from the wilderness waters of the Gulf of Alaska. Our fish are gently harvested one at a time by hand out on the ocean, where the salmon are in prime condition, full of heart, prostate and breast-healthy Omega-3 oil, and at the peak of vigor, taste and freshness. The fish are then immediately dressed and iced fish by hand a process producing the highest quality salmon in Alaska.

feeds.title: The Northern Current | An Alaskan Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Rachel, and I'm a 28-year-old living in Alaska. I grew up in a village in rural Southwest Alaska and moved to Southeast Alaska after graduating from college. I launched The Northern Current in July of 2016, and it has been a really fun way to document our trips, share my favorite recipes, and showcase major changes to our home.

feeds.title: Living in Alaska - Living in the Last Frontier
feeds.description: We spend almost all of our free time 'roadtripping' around Alaska. We have traveled just about every paved road in the state and quite a few gravel roads too. I am never without my camera, and my greatest passion is to capture the grandeur and spectacular beauty of this great state, and share it with you.

feeds.title: AlaskaPhotoGraphics
feeds.description: AlaskaPhotoGraphics is your source for professional Alaska photos. Search through Alaska Stock Photography categories including wildlife, nature, aurora borealis, national parks, and many more. License photos for your commercial publishing needs, or purchase fine art prints for your home or office.
